observed_shape: The shared Day0 h17 residual is 11,799 mark units, only about 9.1%-13.0% of the terminal observable-economic residual magnitude in these five maps.
For all five maps, Day12->Day20 is the largest residual-growth phase among h17->Day4, Day4->Day8, Day8->Day12, Day12->Day20, and Day20->terminal.
Day12->Day20 residual growth ranges from +31,896 to +50,359 mark units.
That Day12->Day20 growth is dominated by Cash residual growth plus Committed Production residual growth; Inventory residual growth is much smaller in all five cases.
Therefore the Day0 productive-State composition is a repeated early shape but is not, by magnitude alone, sufficient reason to make Day0 the main battlefield.
boundary: This is descriptive residual growth, not causal attribution.
The fraction of terminal residual does not mean the Day0 residual caused that fraction of terminal value.
No mechanism, Action, Representation, Evaluation, Direction, Candidate, or policy mutation is inferred.
The purpose residual remains terminal self; this re-entry prevents a small early difference from becoming the main battlefield merely because it is clean.
